outline:
此門課程主要在於瞭解社會學的意涵，並藉由跨領域的學習，讓不同主題能有對話的空間。課程涵蓋的範圍會兼顧理論與實用性，讓學生能思考當今的社會，理解到產生因素的多元性，並進而使個人眼界能更加開拓。期望學生於課程學習中能夠發展更多對於整個社會的不同思維，以強化本身學科之所需，不但具有理論性深入的洞察力，也能運用到社會實踐的層面。
The aim of this course is to understand the concepts of sociology, and provide space of dialog between different subjects. The range of this course includes both theories and applications so that students can investigate multiple causes of social phenomena to broaden their views. Students are expected to develop alternative thinking and strengthens the capabilities of their own subjects. In addition, they can not only think in theoretical ways but also apply developed abilities to social practices.

Rollcall each week. Each absence and late to class will result in deduction of final grade by 2 points and one point relatively. No cellphone and other tasks unrelated with the class are allowed. Violating this rule will result in 5 points deduction of final grade.
